cues.en: We're pretty much done with the core of Svelte now.
However, the developer behind Svelte or the team behind Svelte also released another package called
Sapper, and that is closely connected to Svelte.
It helps us with routing and server side rendering, which is what SSR stands for.
Now why do we need that and what are routing and server side rendering?
We'll have a look at this or at these questions in this module and then we'll see how Sapper works in
general and how it can help us with our meetup project, which is our bigger course project we build
throughout this course and they're in this project.
Some features are missing and as it turns out, Sapper will help us with that.
